newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks rebound in buoyant trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks rebound in buoyant trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks rebounded on Friday in buoyant trade with new gains among blue chips and hoteliers.
* Of fourteen active issues, nine were up, two down, two flat and one was traded for the first time.
* Volume doubled to 21,718 shares, turnover also higher at 20 million kuna.
* Top gainer on volume of only 107 shares was shipper Atlantska Plovidba, up 100 kuna to 180 from early September.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka added five kuna to 1,000, selling 17,119 shares.
* Zagrebacka E-series was bigger of the two decliners, falling 20 kuna to close at 430, with 33 units sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
